description: OMOP CDM v5.4 MEASUREMENT table — structured values (numerical or categorical) obtained through systematic and standardized examination or testing of a Person or Person's sample. Includes laboratory tests, vital signs, and clinical assessments. Coded using LOINC.

fields.label: Measurement ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for each Measurement.

fields.label: Person ID
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the Person about whom the measurement was recorded. The demographic details of that Person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.label: Measurement Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the standard measurement concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies. These are LOINC concepts.

fields.label: Measurement Datetime
fields.description: The date and time of the Measurement.

fields.label: Measurement Type Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined Concept in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the provenance from where the Measurement record was recorded.

fields.label: Operator Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the mathematical operator that is applied to the value_as_number. Operators are (=, ≠, <, ≤, >, ≥).

fields.label: Value As Number
fields.description: A Measurement result where the result is expressed as a numeric value.

fields.label: Value As Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Measurement result represented as a Concept from the Standardized Vocabularies (e.g. positive/negative, present/absent).

fields.label: Unit Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Standard Concept identifier for the unit of the Measurement value.

fields.label: Range Low
fields.description: The lower limit of the normal range of the Measurement result. The lower range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the Measurement value.

fields.label: Range High
fields.description: The upper limit of the normal range of the Measurement result. The upper range is assumed to be of the same unit of measure as the Measurement value.

fields.label: Provider ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the provider in the PROVIDER table who was responsible for initiating or affirming the Measurement.

fields.label: Visit Occurrence ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the Visit in the VISIT_OCCURRENCE table during which the Measurement was recorded.

fields.label: Measurement Source Value
fields.description: The Measurement name as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a Standard Concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

fields.label: Measurement Source Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept in the Standard Vocabularies that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.label: Unit Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the unit as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Value Source Value
fields.description: The source value associated with the content of the value_as_number or value_as_concept_id as stored in the source data.
